title: AddEventListener Request
description: A request to add an event listener for a specified event type to the Desktop Agent.

type.title: Event type
type.description: The type of the event to be listened to or `null` to listen to all event types.

channelId.title: Channel Id
channelId.description: The Id of the Channel that a Channel-scoped listener registration applies to (as registered via `Channel.addEventListener`). Set to `null` for Desktop Agent-level listener registrations (as registered via `DesktopAgent.addEventListener`), whose scope follows the app's current User channel. Currently only relevant to the `CONTEXT_CLEARED` event type.
